# palm-tree: "Formula 1 inspired 2D pixel art car pack"

- **Source:** https://palm-tree.itch.io/formula-1-inspired-2d-pixel-art-car-pack (downloaded by the
  project owner, 2026-10-12; files unmodified).
- **Author:** palm-tree (itch.io).
- **Terms (as read 2026-10-12):** no formal licence file. The author's public replies on the page:
  commercial use, *"Yes, you absolutely can"*; *"feel free to use it however you want. there's no
  charge."* Pay-what-you-want. The author asks for a link to games that use the assets.
- **Contents:** 4 cars "inspired by" the 2021 Red Bull RB16B, Mercedes W12, McLaren MCL35 and Ferrari
  SF-21. Each has a 16×16 PNG (white or track-grey background), GIMP `.xcf` sources and a preview
  screenshot.
- **How F1AR uses it:** only `Ferrari/Ferrari.png`, as a neutral base. In the browser, its white
  background becomes transparent and its single bodywork colour (`#D30400`) is replaced by each
  team's official timing colour, so all ten teams are drawn from one shape and no real livery is
  reproduced. Credit is shown in the viewer footer. See `docs/LEGAL_AND_LICENSES.md` and D-017.
